_about: Bytes each source file and each owner module contributes to the plane's bundle. Measured 23 Nov 2026 by plane-scope research worker 14: buildMember(planeMember()) from bio-plane/scripts/fleet-bundle.mjs, in a scratch worktree at origin/p4-tranche a26a8da2 (a FRESH build; the committed bio-plane/dist bundle is older and smaller, see 14-build-and-run.md). bytesInOutput is esbuild 0.25.12's metafile figure (outputs[...].inputs[path].bytesInOutput), after tree-shaking and whitespace minification, before the bundler's ASCII pass. sourceBytes is the file's size on disk. A file's module is the module whose listed path (files or tests in process/modules/<name>.json) matches it most specifically. position is the module's line in process/modules/order.txt.
